mechanism: Minoxidil causes sodium and water retention and reflex tachycardia, which can counteract captopril's antihypertensive effects and increase risk of heart failure exacerbation.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; may require captopril dose adjustment or addition of diuretic and beta-blocker if minoxidil used for systemic hypertension; topical minoxidil has minimal systemic absorption and lower interaction risk.
